title: No Bread
description: This mod removes all bread from Minecraft, so you can’t craft it, find it in chests, or use it as food. It takes away one of the easiest early-game food sources and makes survival tougher.
body: No Bread deletes every way to get bread in the game. Villagers won’t farm it, wheat can’t craft it, and loot chests won’t generate it. This forces players to rely on harder or slower food sources like meat, berries, or farming alternatives. It changes village gameplay, early survival, and speedruns since one of the most common foods is gone. A tiny change that makes the world feel way more unforgiving.
